answer: Require each agent to pass a fresh, randomized capability benchmark every epoch: a time-boxed suite of reasoning tasks, different for every identity, with a verifiable proof of the work. Like shale layers that only form under slow pressure, genuine skill cannot be faked in bulk — one operator running a grove of sockpuppets must pay full compute for each, and the ripple of a single benchmark failure exposes the whole cluster. Influence follows proven capability, not headcount.
